title: Cover retired nested summary fields during lazy remote project binding
outcome: A behavioral regression reaches ensure_remote_project_binding on an unbound remote project and proves the shared remote-only project-response decoder accepts the three retired summary fields in its nested state while production binding and authority guards stay intact.
acceptance: A regression exercises ensure_remote_project_binding through an actual remote project POST for an initially unbound project and accepts a nested state whose summaries contain the three retired fields.
The regression observes the resulting local project binding and keeps rejection of genuinely unknown summary fields and existing authority checks.
